text: If a fault causes the infusion to be suspended, the pump shall stop pumping immediately, without completing the current stroke.

source.ref: GPCA Safety Requirements (Jetley & Jones 2007), as cited in UPenn PRECISE GPCA materials (unnumbered in the secondary sources consulted)
source.note: Paraphrase. 'Immediately' modeled as within 0 s inclusive (same tick).
